author: Soyuiz
body:
Hello! Here's mine and izjust4fun newest map!

It's a paradise themed map containing deserted ruins, and multiple flowing waterfalls!
There are plenty of pathways and levels to keep the gameplay interesting!
Would work perfectly fine for Nexus and Oitq!
We hope you like it!

Teams - Omnios(Orange)VS Yemnios(Yellow)
Downloads - 
Nexus: http://www.mediafire.com/download/azu3n8cmzy5jaqr/Deserted_Paradise_Nexus.zip
OITC: http://www.mediafire.com/download/875kzhmozi3903e/Deserted_Paradise_OITC.zip

YML - 
 Nexus YML: http://pastebin.com/xJBJam7f
 OITC YML: http://pastebin.com/Nte6wAEc

Pictures - http://imgur.com/a/niarA

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
After making Evil Forest, I've realized I did something wrong, and it was telling you guys the map was "too small". Small maps can actually be fun if they have the correct limit of players, and this map isn't exactly small, more like... medium sized.
Sorry for my mistake, and congratulations!
Accepted for both OITC and Nexus!
